title: CE60128: Hydropower Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Transients in water conductor systems; design of hydropower installation
components - intake structures; water conductor systems tunnels; surge-tanks;
penstocks; valves and anchor-blocks; types of powerhouse - underground and
semi-underground; turbines and their foundations; introduction to structural
and geotechnical aspects of powerhouse design - CAD applications; similitude
and models.
